body:
What is an Incapsula incident ID?

When Imperva blocks you, it shows Request unsuccessful. Incapsula incident ID: ... and loads /_Incapsula_Resource. Here is how to read it.
note: A blog that QUOTES the Incapsula markers in prose but is NOT served by Incapsula: no visid_incap/incap_ses cookie, no X-Iinfo/X-CDN header. The vendor gate must reject it. FP guard.
